method: Two dsx windows (CRISPOR input limit 2,300 bp): W1 AgamP5 NC_064601.1:47,618,700-47,620,999 (2,300 bp; dsx-v3-1 + dsx-v3-2) and W2 47,622,000-47,623,000 (1,001 bp; Kyrou + dsx-v3-3). All four spacers verified present in the submitted sequences by exact string match before submission. pam=NGG (Sp Cas9).

mm1_site.interpretation: the guide's OWN target locus: AgamP4 reference carries allele CATTAAGACCTACGAAGCGT (PAM-distal position 20 C>T) where the guide is ...CGC; already recorded in results/agamp4_reannotation.json (mismatches_vs_AgamP4=1 at 2R:48,712,765-48,712,784). Not a dispersed off-target.

acoln3.note: A. coluzzii reference matches the guide's C allele at position 20 - zero hits through 3 mismatches

cross_engine_comparison.verdict: AGREE: CHOPCHOP AgamP4 MM0/1/2=0 (2 MM3) = CRISPOR AgamP4 MM0/1/2=0 (2 MM3)

AGREE + RESOLVED: CHOPCHOP MM1=1; CRISPOR MM1=1 at the guide's own locus - the AgamP4 reference allele differs at PAM-distal position 20 (C>T). A target-site allele difference between assemblies, not a dispersed off-target. A. coluzzii matches the guide (0 hits through MM3).

DISAGREE: CHOPCHOP reports MM0=2 in AgamP4 (own site + one exact duplicate); CRISPOR reports MM0=0 in AgamP4 and MM0=0 in A. coluzzii. The duplicate is not reproduced by the second independent curated index; the assembly-dependent copy-number flag on dsx-v3-3 is downgraded from confirmed to engine-specific and unresolved.
AGREE after counting conventions: CHOPCHOP MM0=1 is the conserved own site (CHOPCHOP counts the on-target genomic match); CRISPOR excludes own-site matches, MM0=0, nothing nearer than MM4.

cross_species_conservation: All four on-target sites (three leads + Kyrou control) are recovered in the Anopheles coluzzii AcolN3 assembly at the dsx ortholog locus (coluzzii transcripts XM_049607256.1/XM_049607255.1/XM_040369033.2 etc.) with the guide sequences exactly present; the drive target sites are conserved across the two sympatric, hybridizing members of the gambiae complex. dsx-v3-2 and the Kyrou guide have zero hits through 3 mismatches in coluzzii; dsx-v3-1 and dsx-v3-3 are clean through 2 mismatches (2 MM3 each).
